doc.name: Pakki Packaging Brand Directory
doc.instructions: Pakki publishes free, read-only directories of U.S. consumer brands with source-backed flexible packaging observations. Use search_brands to find brands and always cite each result's sourceUrl and reviewedAt. Directory inclusion is not evidence of purchase intent; call get_evidence_policy before drawing conclusions. Full product: https://pakki.ai

tools.name: list_directories
tools.title: List packaging brand directories
tools.description: List the public, source-backed directories of U.S. consumer brands using flexible packaging (pet food, coffee, compostable/recyclable). Returns each directory id, entry count, last update, web page URL, and CSV download URL.

locale.description: Response language: "en" for English or "zh" for Simplified Chinese.

tools.name: search_brands
tools.title: Search packaging brands
tools.description: Search brands in the public flexible packaging directories by keyword (brand name, category, packaging format such as "valve bag", "stand-up pouch", "compostable", or evidence text). Every keyword must match. Each result includes the observed packaging format, official evidence, official source URL, and observation date. Results never contain personal contacts or purchase-intent claims.

query.description: Keywords in English or Chinese. Leave empty to list every brand in scope.

directory.description: Limit the search to one directory id from list_directories.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

offset.description: Number of matching results to skip, for pagination.

locale.description: Response language: "en" for English or "zh" for Simplified Chinese.

tools.name: get_evidence_policy
tools.title: Get evidence policy
tools.description: Explain how to interpret directory data: the Observed / Derived / Inferred / Unknown evidence labels and what public packaging evidence cannot prove. Call this before drawing conclusions about a brand’s suppliers, materials, or buying intent.

locale.description: Response language: "en" for English or "zh" for Simplified Chinese.
